children: The U.S. Treasury's $39 billion auction of 10-year notes on Wednesday might require a price concession for a smooth takedown, J.P. Morgan strategists say in a note. "Given somewhat less supportive valuations both fundamentally and locally, we think tomorrow's [Wednesday's] auction will likely require more of a concession in order to be digested smoothly," they say. In Asian trade, the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield falls 1.2 basis points to 4.790%, according to Tradeweb. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
